instruction: Access the Slide Master by clicking View > Master > Slide Master, find the slide number, and change its font color to green

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide number color to green in the slide master. The evaluator uses the existing check_page_number_colors function which parses the slide master XML to verify the color of the page number placeholder. Verified that check_page_number_colors supports 'green' color check.
metadata.verification: The check_page_number_colors function from slides.py (lines 876-920) parses the slide master XML to find the color of the page number placeholder. It checks the second-to-last solidFill/srgbClr element in the slide master and verifies it matches the expected color using threshold-based RGB comparison (red: R > G+50 and R > B+50, blue: B > G+50 and B > R+50, green: G > R+50 and G > B+50, black: R < 50 and G < 50 and B < 50).
